title: Redefine the board outline as a rectangle
summary: Reads the board outline vertex by vertex and rewrites it as a rectangle with PCB.PolySegment, then makes the board pick it up with SetState_XSizeYSize_1 and UpdateBoardOutline; shows why RebuildBoardOutline discards the written shape.
phrasings: change the board shape from code

commands.name: ReadBoardOutline
commands.description: Read the board outline: point count, layer, each segment (index 0..PointCount) relative to the board origin, and the bounding-rectangle width and height in the display unit and the other unit

commands.name: UpdateBoardRegion
commands.description: Replace the board outline by a rectangle of four line segments and report the resulting size and segments
commands.params: Width=<mil, default 1000>|Height=<mil, default 1000>|CenterX=<mil from the board origin, default 0>|CenterY=<mil from the board origin, default 0>|Rebuild=true (optional, also calls RebuildBoardOutline, which discards the rectangle)
